sources.entry: English Speaking App - AI speaking practice for interviews, meetings, and everyday conversations with live voice feedback. #freemium

summary.name: English Speaking App
summary.one_liner: A free web-based English speaking practice tool where learners talk with a live AI coach about real work or study situations and receive one correction to repeat.
use_cases: Practising workplace English for meetings and updates
Preparing for customer calls in English
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a live voice conversation with an AI speaking assessor named Eleanor. The user speaks unscripted about a real situation, such as work or a recent challenge, and the AI responds to what was actually said. After each answer it gives one specific correction, which the user repeats in a second attempt. The page also presents a ten-minute practice routine, sample feedback, and tips for tracking progress such as pause length and restarts. It states the practice suits roughly A2 to C1 learners and that no preparation is needed.
notable: Live unscripted voice conversation with an AI coach that responds to what you actually say
One correction per answer, followed by an immediate repeat attempt
Structured ten-minute practice routine and progress signals
Free daily allowance to start, with longer sessions on paid plans
caveats: Longer or more frequent sessions need a paid plan; details are on a separate pricing page not included here
Suited to roughly A2 to C1 level; complete beginners need core vocabulary and listening first
Does not remove an accent, by its own description
